rng_stream_convention: single shared np.random.default_rng(99) stream, sequential over event index -- IDENTICAL to v2/v3/v4

files.raw_hit_cache: conversion_photon_hit_cache_sample100_v1.npz (one row per pre-merge hit, linked by event+raw_hit_id)
files.merged_hit_cache: conversion_photon_hit_cache_sample100_v1_merged.npz (one row per post-merge hit, linked by event+merged_hit_id)

known_gaps.raw_to_merged_provenance: NOT individually resolved to specific raw_hit_id lists in this prototype (merge cluster membership is only implicit via merged_count; an exact raw<->merged join was judged unnecessary for the requested cache questions and was not built to keep this prototype bounded)
known_gaps.acceptance_reason_detail: simulate_quirk_hits does not separately count/report eta- or timing-rejected raw crossings (they are filtered inline and never appended to raw_hits) -- 'acceptance_reason' column is a placeholder, not a real per-crossing rejection log

note: This is a SMALL-SAMPLE PROTOTYPE (n=100), not a full-statistics cache. No full 9139-event propagation run was performed to build it.
